instruction.text: Philip has 47 pens. Select the number 47 on the grid.

4 of Philip’s pens run out of ink.
How many pens with ink does Philip have now?
Count down from 47 and select the correct number on the grid.
James has 83 blueberries. Select the number 83 on the grid.

James collects another 8 blueberries.
How many blueberries does James have now?
Count up from 83 and select the correct number on the grid.
Daryll has 61 beads. Select the number 61 on the grid.

Daryll uses 9 beads to make a bracelet.
How many beads does Daryll have now?
Count down from 61 and select the correct number on the grid.
Jonas has 73 stickers. Select the number 73 on the grid.

Jonas collects another 6 stickers.
How many stickers does Jonas have now?
Count up from 73 and select the correct number on the grid.
